facts.text: Notebook (feed): The Oaks lost in Chicago as Mike Paulson's served as GM last season in Chicago along with his then assistant Elliot Abraham. Abraham now serves as the Oaks GM while Paulson is President of Operations.

Oaks — game-result (preseason), C110: The Oaks visit the Chicago Bulls, The Oaks lose their 4th straight pre-season game. The Chicago Bulls, where Paulson ran the the front office last season, gets the better of him in this matchup

Notebook (feed): The Oaks lose their final preseason game bringing the total franchise record to 0-9 through rookie camp and preseason. Wilson Shepard reassures that the full team has yet to suit up as one and opening
Oaks — game-result (preseason), C110: The Oaks welcome the Miami Heat to Oakland to lose their final preseason game. The Oaks are winless as a franchise between rookie camp and preseason.
